_readme: S639 harvest side session, 2026-11-12. Rio Hondo College, third read. This read prints the same _getPage call with keywords on the figures and on the HTML's own spacing, so the excerpts carry whatever section 8 prints for Cal-GETC's areas and any total. No model call.
